field_contracts.render_request: render requests declare request id, render mode, formats, artifact policy, and renderer dependency gate without importing renderers
field_contracts.request_envelope: request envelopes carry deterministic replay keys, fixture key, live network flag, and real dependency import flag
field_contracts.render_result: render results carry status, output manifest, artifact manifest, snapshots, warnings, annotations, and clean-skip state
field_contracts.output_manifest: output manifests declare logical output ids, media types, artifact refs, and fixture-only URI policy
field_contracts.artifact_manifest: artifact manifests record artifact ids, URIs, hashes, media types, and remote-fetch=false policy
field_contracts.snapshot_metadata: snapshot metadata records page/viewport ids, deterministic inputs, hash algorithm, and snapshot hash
field_contracts.warnings: warnings normalize table, markdown, missing chart, stale content, and renderer-skip messages
field_contracts.annotations: annotations normalize source, disclosure, accessibility, and risk notes without domain-specific report sections
field_contracts.fixture_hash: fixture hashes are deterministic sha256 values derived from provider-free fixture seeds
field_contracts.clean_skip: clean skips return skipped render envelopes for absent renderer, browser, writer, or disabled network states
